name: @jsails/filesystem
description: Local, in-memory, and S3 Disk implementations, lazily materialized variants, and the filesystem plugin for JSails.
author: Ronald Wong <ronald2wing@gmail.com>

scripts.build:clean: npm run clean && npm run build

jsails.name: Filesystem
jsails.summary: Local, in-memory, and S3 disks with lazily materialized file variants.

env.name: FILESYSTEM_DISK
env.description: The backend of an env-driven disk: local (the default), s3, or memory.

env.name: FILESYSTEM_LOCAL_ROOT
env.description: The root of an env-driven local disk, relative to the application root.

env.name: S3_BUCKET
env.description: The bucket of an env-driven S3 disk.

env.name: S3_REGION
env.description: The region of an env-driven S3 disk.

env.name: S3_ENDPOINT
env.description: The endpoint of an S3-compatible store other than AWS.

env.name: S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE
env.description: Whether to address the bucket in the path rather than the host name.

env.name: S3_PREFIX
env.description: The key prefix every object of an env-driven S3 disk is stored under.

env.name: S3_CONDITIONAL_WRITES
env.description: Off for a store that ignores If-None-Match; on by default.

env.name: S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID
env.description: The access key of an env-driven S3 disk.

env.name: S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
env.description: The secret key of an env-driven S3 disk.

env.name: S3_SESSION_TOKEN
env.description: The session token of temporary S3 credentials.
